bio.text: Nancy Pelosi represents California's 11th Congressional District, covering San Francisco, and was first elected to the U.S. House in a 1987 special election; she is not running for re-election in 2026.
In 2007 she became the first woman elected Speaker of the House, and she is Speaker Emerita.
She was born in Baltimore, Maryland, graduated from the Institute of Notre Dame in 1958 and earned a bachelor's degree from Trinity College in 1962.
She previously chaired the California Democratic Party.
